newsitem.title: JAPAN: Foreigners net sellers of Japanese stocks in week.
newsitem.headline: Foreigners net sellers of Japanese stocks in week.

text.p: Foreigners were net sellers of Japanese stocks on the Tokyo, Osaka and Nagoya stock exchanges in the week of October 21 to 25, exchange data issued on Thursday showed.
Foreigners have been net sellers for the past three weeks after buying continuously for the past five weeks, according to the data. The figures, which are rounded, are as follows:
Previous week net selling 73.03 billion yen
